title: ARTLabs — ARTPARK @IISc - Leading AI & Robotics startup incubation
text:
ARTLabs
Big Ideas, Real Impact

ARTLabs represents the early stage of ARTPARK’s innovation pipeline - a space where bold ideas are transformed into tangible innovations, technologies, and ventures. It brings together deep-tech researchers, engineers, and entrepreneurs to build, validate, and scale cutting-edge solutions across AI, robotics, health, climate, and advanced systems.

Innovation Projects

Innovation projects are led by Innovators-in-Residence and focus on solving real-world problems with the potential to evolve into venture-backed startups. These projects emphasize product-market fit, early validation, and commercialization.
